subject: Omnisource V10 live-fusion/reentry candidate revised by live work-revision evidence
hypothesis: Provenance-bound all-source intake plus semantic epoch gates, current-work revision binding and explicit reentry closure can reduce stale/correlated research-state errors without granting ingestion, graph activation or delivery truth/authority.
strongest_counterhypothesis: The layer may add more storage, latency, false materiality and coordination cost than it removes; V9/manual or simpler routing may dominate on real repo workloads.

fresh_internal_evidence.finding: A technically successful self-hosted execution can be bound to an older work revision. Stale executions must remain diagnostic-only for current-work credit.
fresh_internal_evidence.effect_on_candidate: V10 revised to bind work_id/spec_rev/repo_head/execution_start/component hashes and separate current_work_credit_eligible from semantic promotion eligibility.

fresh_external_evidence.role: IVM update complexity varies with query/semiring structure
late/lost distributed data motivates time-consistent checkpoint recovery
incremental provenance can support localized rollback
counterevidence: small graph deltas can propagate globally

local_evidence.specific_material_reentry: pending 1 -> 0 and remains CLOSED after restart
local_evidence.performance_interpretation: Stronger guard has observable overhead in the same general sandbox lane; not yet a formal matched causal microbenchmark.

out_of_box_experiment.name: temporal_braid_fault
out_of_box_experiment.interpretation: Same final state can hide transient stale causal corruption.

clayresearch.delta: Track source coverage, material reentry closure, stale-work credit rejection, false materiality and resource overhead as joint research metrics.
clayresearch.next_test: Real repo replay vs V9/manual refresh.

frank.delta: Frank telemetry is an input source only; stale or repeated Frank-originated proposals cannot gain Harness authority through fusion.
frank.next_test: Replay a Frank self-observation Harness proposal through V10 and verify PROPOSAL_ONLY authority.

gwt.delta: Persist delivered/reconstructed/plan-revalidated/used/effect distinctions for research deltas; exposure is not causal uptake.
gwt.next_test: Use irrelevant/shuffled research deltas as uptake controls.

emergenz.delta: More sources/coupling are not emergence evidence; monitor consensus collapse and stale-cascade amplification.
emergenz.next_test: Lesion high-centrality source and routing edge separately.

claycode.delta: V10 records plus current-work binding are concrete WP03 typed-IR/type-effect expressibility targets; no semantic redesign without executable gap.
claycode.next_test: Compile minimal V10 record/reentry program once WP03 path is executable.

hyperposition.delta: Preserve conflicting evidence histories and route/refresh alternatives; arrival order is not epistemic order.
hyperposition.next_test: Compare same final state with different provenance histories.

claygraph.delta: No new truth graph needed; existing invalidation/receiver/projection receipts remain routing/observability plane.
claygraph.next_test: Missing-edge/stale-projection replay with repair and branch-recall measurements.

unifieddb.delta: V10 is TESTING with semantic+work revision guards, provenance preservation, reentry receipts and restart checkpoints; V9 remains rollback/promoted baseline.
unifieddb.next_test: Self-hosted Ubuntu + actual repository replay/fault matrix.

harness.delta: Runtime/failure/recovery evidence can enter V10 but only current-spec exact-bound receipts may receive current Harness work credit.
harness.next_test: Feed H1 failure/recovery trace through V10 and verify regression/work closure without authority inflation.

global_controls: stale work execution diagnostic-only for current-work credit
V10 remains TESTING; V9 rollback baseline
Frank remains separate research subject and never mutates Clay
next_frontier: Actual current-repo replay with work-revision churn and missing/stale graph dependencies
Self-hosted receipt if and only if workflow actually returns one
Matched V9/manual vs V10 cost/correctness benchmark
Do not displace the BASE ClayCode critical path
